recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not rename ImagingStudy.subject to patient unless a future work-group decision narrows the element back to Patient-only.
issue_request: FHIR-3704 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request to rename ImagingStudy.subject to ImagingStudy.patient because the element was then Patient-only and the cited naming guideline uses patient only when Patient is the only reasonable subject.
initial_application: The request was historically applied by git commit 9567767b1d930e2b478f74866cb5039e3acef23d on 2014-11-29, which renamed the then-current ImagingStudy element, example, and search-path rows from subject to patient.
additional_context: FHIR-14147 later reached Published/Persuasive with Modification for the same element family and changed the name back to subject while adding Device and Group subject targets and a series-level specimen reference. Commit d21acd48143d1cbe35a35616864c97839b13a361 applied that later update. The current build actively includes ImagingStudy and defines ImagingStudy.subject as Reference(Patient, Device, Group), with ImagingStudy.series.specimen handling Specimen and search parameters covering both Patient-only and broader subject searches.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reapplying FHIR-3704 to the current build would be wrong because the current element is no longer Patient-only; the current source already follows the original naming guideline by using subject when non-Patient targets are possible.
